projects.title: Theme Exploration in Public Programming Questions

bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the project workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration using scikit-learn; examined topic stability across repeated fits and inspected supplied public programming questions supporting each interpretation.
Cleaned supplied post metadata tables using pandas and provided steps; plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
